name: DL-methionine; chemical synthesis; at processing plant
description: This unit process is a cradle-to-gate dataset of production of 1 kg  DL-methionine. Does not include water or land use.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Represents production at the national level.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: The authors  assumed that the production of 1 kg of DL-methionine required 0.43 kg of propylene, 0.27 kg of hydrogen sulfide, 0.39 kg of methanol, 0.21 kg of hydrogen cyanide and 7.4MJ of process energy at the plant, supplied as electricity (50%) and natural gas (50%).
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: The authors  assumed that the production of 1 kg of DL-methionine required 0.43 kg of propylene, 0.27 kg of hydrogen sulfide, 0.39 kg of methanol, 0.21 kg of hydrogen cyanide and 7.4MJ of process energy at the plant, supplied as electricity (50%) and natural gas (50%). The literature data did not provide on plant water use and land occupation
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Full dataset was taken from Mosnier et al. (2011).
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: The unit process was built based on the work of Mosnier et al. (2011).
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Authors obtained the amino acid production data from the EU working group (EU Association of Specialty Feed Ingredients and their Mixtures, personal communication, 2010).
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project from 2013 through 2015.

sources.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
